title: average texture pack
description: This resource pack may appear to simplify some textures into single flat colors if they were exported in an incompatible format. This usually happens when textures are saved in indexed color mode, reduced-palette PNGs, or improperly exported layers, which
body:
Average Texture Pack
A simple resource pack that tweaks Minecraft visuals by simplifying textures and giving blocks a cleaner, more minimal look.

Misc
You can use this in any modpack you would like.
